chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yasser, from Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
The Tabarzand sugar consumes the phlegm with a devouring.

key_terms.الطَّبَرْزَدُ: Tabarzand (a specific type of sugar from Tabaristan)

ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of Tabarzand sugar according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) identifies 'Tabarzand' sugar as a specific medicinal variety known for its ability to dissolve phlegm (balgham), reflecting the Greco-Arabic humoral theory prevalent in Shia medical tradition. This highlights the Imam’s role not only as a spiritual guide but also as a source of practical health knowledge, linking dietary choices to bodily balance. The specificity of the term 'Tabarzand' suggests a recognized regional or processed type of sugar valued for its therapeutic efficacy in clearing respiratory and digestive humors.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yasser, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Al-Tabarzad sugar eats up the phlegm with a devouring’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Yasar who has said the following: “Al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The sugar chipped with a small hammer dissolves phlegm entirely.’”
